title: ononis pedicellaris
intro: Ononis pedicellaris, commonly known as Burn Clover, is a type of flowering plant in the legume family Fabaceae. This plant has been traditionally used for its medicinal properties, particularly in treating digestive issues and skin problems. The health benefits of Burn Clover include its anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which may help alleviate symptoms of conditions such as eczema and irritable bowel syndrome. The therapeutic actions of Burn Clover are attributed to its bioactive constituents, including flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, which have been shown to exhibit antimicrobial and antiseptic properties.
